methods.name: Saliency *(Vanilla Grad)*
methods.characteristics: Raw output gradient. Prone to gradient saturation & high-frequency noise.

methods.name: Input × Gradient
methods.characteristics: Scales gradient by input pixel intensity; improves baseline sharpness.

methods.name: Guided Backpropagation
methods.characteristics: Overrides ReLU backward rules; acts partly as an edge detector.

methods.name: DeepLift
methods.characteristics: Decomposes output w.r.t baseline; avoids zero-gradient saturation.

methods.name: Integrated Gradients (IG)
methods.characteristics: Satisfies Axioms of Completeness & Implementation Invariance.

methods.name: Gradient SHAP
methods.characteristics: Game-theoretic SHAP approximation using Gaussian noise sampling.

methods.name: DeepLift SHAP
methods.characteristics: Combines DeepLift difference propagation with SHAP baseline sampling.

methods.name: Layer Grad-CAM
methods.characteristics: Class-discriminative coarse spatial localization upsampled to input size.

models.name: ResNet-50
models.characteristics: Benchmark residual network with identity skip connections to prevent vanishing gradients.

models.name: ConvNeXt-Tiny
models.characteristics: Modernized pure CNN adopting ViT design choices ($7\times7$ depthwise convs, LayerNorm).

models.name: DenseNet-121
models.characteristics: Densely connected layers maximizing feature reuse across all feed-forward stages.

models.name: EfficientNet-B0
models.characteristics: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) model scaled via compound depth/width/resolution rules.

models.name: MobileNet-V3 Large
models.characteristics: Mobile architecture with inverted bottleneck blocks and hard-swish activation functions.

models.name: RegNet-Y 8GF
models.characteristics: Quantized linear design space network optimized for high hardware execution throughput.

models.name: ViT-B/16
models.characteristics: Non-convolutional patch-based Transformer ($16\times16$ tokens, locked $224\times224$ input).

models.name: Swin-Tiny
models.characteristics: Hierarchical Vision Transformer with shifted window self-attention mechanisms.

metrics.name: Attribution Runtime
metrics.definition: Microsecond-accurate timer (`time.perf_counter`) with hardware device sync (`torch.cuda.synchronize()`).

metrics.name: Peak Memory
metrics.definition: Maximum allocated VRAM/RAM captured via PyTorch allocators or CPU process profiling.

metrics.name: Gini Index (Sparsity)
metrics.definition: $\text{Gini}(\mathbf{A}) = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^N (2i - N - 1) \vert a_{(i)} \vert}{N \sum_{i=1}^N \vert a_{(i)} \vert}$ *(0.0 = uniform blur, 1.0 = focused)*.
